import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] comb = new long[61][61];
    static int R, C;
    static String S;
    static ArrayList<Pair>[] dpL = new ArrayList[31];
    static ArrayList<Pair>[] dpR = new ArrayList[31];
    static long ans = 0;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long first;
        int second;
        Pair(long f, int s) { first = f; second = s; }
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            if (this.first < o.first) return -1;
            if (this.first > o.first) return 1;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    static void init() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        R = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        S = sc.next();
        comb[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 60; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                comb[i][j] = comb[i-1][j];
                if (j > 0) comb[i][j] += comb[i-1][j-1];
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 31; i++) {
            dpL[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            dpR[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void dfsL(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpL[a].add(new Pair(p, mask));
            return;
        }
        dfsL(ind+1, a+1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), p + (comb[a+1][R] - comb[a][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsL(ind+1, a, b+1, mask, p - (comb[b+1][R] - comb[b][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static void dfsR(int ind, int a, int b, int mask, long p) {
        if (ind == C + 1) {
            dpR[a].add(new Pair(p, mask));
            return;
        }
        dfsR(ind+1, a-1, b, mask ^ (1 << ind), p + (comb[a][R] - comb[a-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[b][R]));
        dfsR(ind+1, a, b-1, mask, p - (comb[b][R] - comb[b-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[a][R]));
    }

    static int rev(int x, int y) {
        int z = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            if ((x & (1 << i)) != 0) z ^= 1 << (y - 1 - i);
        }
        return z;
    }

    static void check(long x, int t) {
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2*C+1; i++) {
            if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) a++;
            else b++;
            if (a > 0 && b > 0) {
                for (int j = i; j <= 2*C+1; j++) {
                    if ((x & (1L << j)) != 0) {
                        if (S.charAt(S.length() - (2*C+2) + j) == 'B') return;
                    } else {
                        if (S.charAt(S.length() - (2*C+2) + j) == 'A') return;
                    }
                }
                int aa = 0, bb = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < S.length() - (2*C+2) + i; j++) {
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'A') aa++;
                    if (S.charAt(j) == 'B') bb++;
                }
                long tmp;
                if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) {
                    tmp = comb[R - 1 - aa + b + R - 1 - bb][R - 1 - aa];
                } else {
                    tmp = comb[a + R - 1 - aa + R - 1 - bb][a + R - 1 - aa];
                }
                ans += t * tmp;
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean ok(long x) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= C; i++) {
            if ((x & (1L << i)) != 0) {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'B') return false;
            } else {
                if (S.charAt(S.length() - C - 1 + i) == 'A') return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }

    static long calc(String t) {
        long res = 0;
        int a = 0, b = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < t.length(); i++) {
            if (t.charAt(i) == 'A') {
                a++;
                res += (comb[a][R] - comb[a-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[b][R]);
            } else {
                b++;
                res -= (comb[b][R] - comb[b-1][R]) * (comb[R+C][R] - comb[a][R]);
            }
        }
        if (a != b) return INF;
        return res;
    }

    static boolean match(String t) {
        for (int i = 0; i < S.length(); i++) {
            if (!(S.charAt(i) == '?' || S.charAt(i) == t.charAt(i))) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        init();
        dfsL(0, R-1, R-1, 0, 0);
        dfsR(0, R+C, R+C, 0, 0);
        long dif = INF;
        for (int i = 0; i <= R+C; i++) {
            Collections.sort(dpL[i]);
            Collections.sort(dpR[i], Collections.reverseOrder());
            int idx = 0;
            for (Pair t : dpL[i]) {
                while (idx + 1 < dpR[i].size() && t.first + dpR[i].get(idx+1).first >= 0) idx++;
                dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t.first + dpR[i].get(idx).first));
                if (idx+1 < dpR[i].size()) dif = Math.min(dif, Math.abs(t.first + dpR[i].get(idx+1).first));
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= R+C; i++) {
            ArrayList<Pair> z = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Pair t : dpR[i]) {
                if (ok(rev(t.second, C+1))) z.add(t);
            }
            int l = 0, r = -1;
            for (Pair t : dpL[i]) {
                while (l < z.size() && t.first + z.get(l).first > dif) l++;
                while (r+1 < z.size() && t.first + z.get(r+1).first >= -dif) r++;
                if (l <= r) check(t.second | ((long)rev(z.get(l).second, C+1) << (C+1)), r - l + 1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
